leagues.quote: The Torneo Apertura was the 133rd official División de Honor championship and the first tournament of the 2026 season. It began on 23 January and ended on 24 May 2026.
leagues.note: 12 clubs; each tournament is a separate championship (Apertura won by Olimpia, 48th title) with its own table and no annual final. Clausura: 'It began on 24 July and is scheduled to end on 29 November 2026'. Points from both tournaments are combined into an aggregate table used only for the remaining Libertadores/Sudamericana berths. Relegation is a three-season points-per-game average, bottom two (Rubio Ñu, San Lorenzo).

leagues.quote: El certamen se desarrolló del 4 de abril al 26 de octubre. ... Es campeón el equipo que acumula la mayor cantidad de puntos al término de las 30 fechas.
leagues.note: No Apertura/Clausura: 16 clubs, one double round-robin of 30 rounds in two 15-round halves, with a break in mid-June/early July for the 2026 World Cup. Champion and runner-up are promoted (Deportivo Santaní, General Caballero JLM). Three teams are relegated on the three-season points average (3 de Noviembre, Tacuary, Fernando de la Mora); Asunción-area clubs drop to Primera B, the rest to Primera B Nacional.
